messages:
Nina: quick follow-up from the postmortem \/ key DR items grouped into owners. proposing a focused failback + snapshot-chain validation game-day next Fri 09:00 PT. pls claim.
Tom: i'll own route convergence checks and route-announcement damping settings. will add a scripted convergence timer and baseline compare.
Yara: i'll take snapshot-chain validation (incremental snapshots + manifest chaining) and measured restore timings. adding md5/sha checks and a replay timer.
Tom: recurring pattern note: route convergence window stretches during scale bursts; adding pre-check to ensure no new announcements in the 15m pre-window and measure AS-path consistency.
Nina: owners & short deliverables:
- Tom: route_convergence_check.sh + pre-game cronjob to block announcements 15m before game-day. due Wed EOD.
- Yara: snapshot_chain_audit + restore_speed_measurements, update failback_playbook.md with explicit timings. due Wed EOD.
- Nina: schedule game-day, adjust DNS TTLs, coordinate infra capacity and oncall overlap.
Yara: snippet i'll include in runbook:
```
# verify snapshot chain and checksums
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-backups/prod/snapshots/manifest-$(date -I).json - | jq -r '.chain[]' | xargs -I{} aws s3api head-object --bucket redwood-backups --key {} || exit 1
# timed restore to ephemeral namespace
time_start=$(date +%s)
run-restore --snapshot latest --target /tmp/check && time_end=$(date +%s)
echo "restore_seconds=$((time_end-time_start))"
```
Tom: pre-check plan: run bgp-diff vs baseline and fail if any new prefixes or local-pref reorder detected. will also add route dampening parameters to the runbook.
Nina: ops-bot will post a reminder 45m before the window and the short checklist 30m prior. Dev-bot: schedule pls.
Dev-bot: Reminder scheduled: game-day Fri 09:00 PT. Checklist will post 30 minutes before start.
Tom: small gotcha — CDN geo-steering had stale entries during last failback; adding a quick purge step for CDN caches post-restore.
Yara: also adding a cache warmup plan: staggered client reconnects + token-cache prepopulate script. won't rehydrate all at once.
Nina: please react with ":white_check_mark:" to accept and add estimated hours on the action board. i'll move items to the postmortem tracker and close thread when invites are live.
Tom: :white_check_mark: 4h.
Yara: :white_check_mark: 6h.
Nina: thanks team \/ will send invites and link failback_playbook.md. closing this thread and exporting actions to the tracker.
